edited: The JSON columns of these rows are written by the protobuf library (JsonFormatter), in proto3's JSON mapping: a 64-bit integer is a string, an enum is its name, an absent message or an empty list is "" where the Go server wrote "null", and a number JSON has no form for (NaN, an infinity) is written as text instead of emptying the column. The Go server wrote them with encoding/json over its generated structs.
